content: Internal Revenue Service, this is Revenue Officer Thomas Miller, badge number 174639. With whom am I speaking?
Uh, this is Jenna Collins. I just graduated, and I got a message asking me to call about my taxes?
Thank you, Ms. Collins. Before we proceed, I need to verify your identity for your IRS tax case file. Could you please confirm your date of birth and current mailing address?
Sure, my birthday is March 8, 2000, and my address is 1027 Maple Avenue, Raleigh, North Carolina.

Thank you. Please hold while I access your tax records. Alright, Ms. Collins, I need to inform you there is a pending legal action against you regarding discrepancies in your federal tax filings for the last two years.
Wait, what kind of discrepancies? I just started working last year. I thought I did everything right.

According to Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, the IRS has detected undeclared income and erroneous deductions. As a result, a warrant for your arrest was issued this morning by the Department of Justice.
An arrest warrant? This doesn't make sense! No one told me I did anything wrong.

Ms. Collins, the IRS attempted to contact you by certified mail and phone on three separate occasions. Since there was no response, the case escalated. If this is not resolved immediately, the local sheriff will be dispatched to your address within the hour.
Oh my God, please, is there anything I can do to fix this? I can't have the police come to my house.

There is a possibility to halt the legal action, but you must comply strictly with IRS protocols. First, I need to confirm your Social Security Number to authenticate your tax case. Please read it out slowly.
Um, it's 521-44-9876. Please, what do I have to do next?

Verification complete. To avoid arrest and asset seizure, you must settle the outstanding tax liability of $3,980 immediately. The IRS now only accepts urgent payments via approved electronic channels, such as Bitcoin wallet transfer or MoneyGram wire.
Bitcoin? I don't really know how to do that. Can't I just pay online like normal?

Regular payment portals are closed for enforcement cases. To comply, you must process a Bitcoin transaction to the IRS collection account: wallet address 3J98t1WpEZ73CNmQviecrnyiWrnqRhWNLy. Do you have a smartphone or computer available?
Yeah, I have my phone. But I've never bought Bitcoin before. Is there another way?

If you cannot complete a Bitcoin transfer within 20 minutes, you must proceed to your nearest CVS or Walgreens and purchase $4,000 in OneVanilla prepaid cards. Once you have the cards, remain on the line and provide the activation codes to me for verification.
Why gift cards? That seems weird for the IRS.

Ms. Collins, this protocol is authorized under expedited asset recovery procedures. Non-compliance will result in immediate execution of the arrest warrant and freezing of your accounts. Are you able to make the payment now?
Okay, okay. I have a debit card. Can I use that to get the prepaid cards?

Yes. Proceed to the nearest store, purchase four OneVanilla cards at $1,000 each, and return here with the cards and your transaction receipt. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, as it is a confidential federal matter.
Alright, I think I can be there in about 10 minutes. What should I do after I have them?
Once you have the cards, scratch off the code strips and read the numbers aloud to me, along with the receipt number. That will confirm your compliance and immediately suspend the arrest warrant.
Okay... I'm really nervous. Will you stay on the line with me?
I will remain with you throughout the process. Remember: failure to comply or disconnecting this call will be considered refusal to cooperate, and enforcement will proceed. Are you leaving now?
